verdict.rationale: Unleash's quickstart documents the whole path. A hosted instance is ready without local setup, you create your first flag in the Admin UI and connect an SDK, and per-environment configurations let you enable a flag in production in real time without redeploying. All parts of the story are covered by first-party docs, but the 'within minutes' speed is only implied by the ready-to-use instance and quickstart framing. missing for 10: explicit time-to-first-production-toggle evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of a fast signup-to-production flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: This gives you a ready-to-use instance, so you can explore all Unleash features without any local setup.
Create your first feature flag using the Unleash Admin UI.
use one of the client or backend SDKs to connect Unleash with your application
each environment has different feature flag configurations. This allows you to enable a flag in development or test without enabling it in production.
Release, experiment, and kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys.
